_comment: Central feature registry. Every flag is a presentation switch for a capability that the source PDF, the owner's reference pictures and the owner's explicit requests do not require. Out-of-scope capabilities default to false and stay hidden until the owner asks for them. Edit this file, then run: python tools/build_features.py. Verify with: python tools/feature_parity_check.py.

ticketsBoardView.reason: Optional Kanban board grouped by status. The owner asked for the board to be off by default; the list and cards views remain.

workspaceCommandPalette.reason: Optional global search dialog opened from the top bar or Ctrl/Cmd K. The register keeps its own quick and advanced search.

maintenancePlanner.reason: Optional month, week and agenda calendar. The schedule list, check log and job register remain.

dashboardKpiSparklines.reason: Optional seven day sparklines under the dashboard KPI tiles. The tiles and their counts remain.

designGallery.reason: Development gallery and framed screen previews. It is not a workspace screen; the signed-in product starts at the dashboard.

rolesReferencePage.reason: Standalone roles and access matrix. No signed-in navigation reaches it, so a direct address gets the neutral screen. Role enforcement itself is unchanged.

ticketJumpPicker.reason: A second ticket chooser and filter inside the ticket detail page. Appendix E.2 defines the detail page without it; the register keeps its own queues and search.

requestIdempotencyField.reason: A developer-facing duplicate protection key shown on the intake form. The PDF describes intake channels, not a key field; the key still travels with the request.

demoIntakeSimulation.reason: Demo traffic simulation: the Configuration switch and the records it invents. The PDF has no simulated intake, so with the flag off no ticket is created on its own and normal intake and reminders stay.

profilePasswordChange.reason: In-app password change card. Sign-in uses Google Workspace OIDC, so passwords are owned by Google; contact details and theme remain.

notificationPopupsToggle.reason: Pop-up preference inside the notification tray. Assignment notifications and the notification centre stay.
